companyFieldUpdates.description: Torch Clean Energy is an integrated U.S. renewable independent power producer that develops, owns, and monetizes utility-scale solar, wind, and battery-storage projects. The company reports more than 1.6 GW originated, developed, or sold across over 20 projects in eight states, with activity including the Desert Southwest, Michigan, and the Southeast. Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners announced its platform-equity investment on January 21, 2025 and continues to list Torch as a portfolio company. The exact legal closing date, stake, control terms, fund, acquisition vehicle, retained founder ownership, and any co-investors are not publicly disclosed.
